## Operating picture

Fieldworks coordinates equipment deliveries around dealership receiving hours. The west receiving door at the prairie service yard gets both tractor arrivals and parts vans; apparently a painted line is expected to settle that argument.

The morning dispatcher wants the “Dealer Arrivals” report sorted by dealership, then appointment time. Current exports make the first shift hunt through yesterday’s late arrivals.

## Account boundary

Marrow Fieldworks is the parent company of Marrow Agrisupply. Keep their scheduling questions separate; the parts-counter workflow is not the equipment-unloading workflow.

## Next steps

Tobias Rendle will collect two example exports and the receiving supervisor’s door labels before the next walkthrough. Start with the morning queue, not another tour of every settings screen.
